definition: features locatable in most proteins of most lineages
evidence_required_to_assign_a_feature_he: the feature is located in at least 90 percent of proteins in at least 5 of the 6 lineages, under the frozen instrument and stable across the perturbation ensemble
measured_candidate: A_DYAD is the only current candidate: 94.9 percent broad occupancy, but it fails the 90 percent bar in 7 families including Retrons at 89.6, so on present evidence it is T2 rather than T1
how_reported: per-lineage occupancy with the denominator, never a single pooled rate
what_may_NOT_be_concluded: that a T1 feature is present in every RT; the rate is a rate

definition: features present in multiple lineages but demonstrably absent or unlocatable in others
evidence_required_to_assign_a_feature_he: located in at least 90 percent of proteins in at least 2 lineages AND below 90 percent in at least one, with the low lineage shown to be inspectable
measured_candidate: A_DYAD as currently measured: 100 percent in 17 UG families and AbiA/AbiK/AbiP2, against UG13 at 52.0 percent
how_reported: the occupancy matrix, lineage by feature, with anchor-poor families flagged as predeclared
what_may_NOT_be_concluded: that a lineage lacking the feature has lost it - see V12

definition: features locatable only within one lineage
evidence_required_to_assign_a_feature_he: located in at least 90 percent of one lineage and below 10 percent in all others, on inspectable full-length sequence
measured_candidate: NONE MEASURED YET. The historical RT0 candidate would sit here if it proves GII-restricted, which is the V11 test
how_reported: per-lineage, with the inspectability of the negative lineages shown
what_may_NOT_be_concluded: that the feature originated in that lineage, or that others lost it - this is Stage 06 territory

definition: sequence lying between conserved anchors, measured relative to them
evidence_required_to_assign_a_feature_he: both flanking anchors located on the same protein
measured_candidate: DIRECTLY MEASURABLE ONCE ANCHORS ARE PLACED, and the most robust architecture quantity available because it needs no region edges. The full-length substrate is what makes it measurable at all
how_reported: inter-anchor length distributions by family, with anchor uncertainty propagated
what_may_NOT_be_concluded: that an insertion is a domain; a length is a length

definition: sequence N-terminal or C-terminal to the outermost anchor
evidence_required_to_assign_a_feature_he: the outermost anchor located, and the protein not truncated
measured_candidate: ALREADY MEASURED against the RVT_1 window: median N-terminal extension 97 aa, mean 112.3, max 631; 62.0 percent of source proteins carry at least 80 aa N-terminal. Per family the median ranges from Retrons 51 aa to UG10 468 aa
how_reported: N-terminal and C-terminal extension length distributions by family
what_may_NOT_be_concluded: that an extension is a fused domain without independent domain evidence - that is Stage 08
denominator: proteins with the outermost anchor located

definition: sequence for which no homologous correspondence is supported
evidence_required_to_assign_a_feature_he: the default. Sequence enters T6 unless positively assigned elsewhere
measured_candidate: expected to be substantial, and reporting it honestly is the point
how_reported: as a fraction of each protein and of each family, always visible
what_may_NOT_be_concluded: nothing. T6 is the honest residue and may not be quietly dropped from denominators

definition: the tiers are assigned from measurement, never from expectation
unit: no feature is placed in T1 because the literature calls it universal

definition: this hierarchy replaces a fixed region count
unit: no number of regions - six, seven or any other - is an output of this design

definition: T4 and T5 are the deliverables most likely to survive
what_may_NOT_be_concluded: inter-anchor spacing and terminal extensions need only anchors, not edges, so they are robust to the boundary problem that has defeated three design rounds
unit: they are architecture measurements, not domain calls

definition: fusions are retained and flagged, never excised
how_reported: CRISPR has 18 members above 900 aa; UG5 61 of 67; UG1 30 of 31; UG10 max 1,879 aa
what_may_NOT_be_concluded: flagged as a fusion sub-stratum within their family
unit: that a long protein is a fusion without independent domain evidence
